questions: Is the sequence S considered ordered? That is, are permutations of the same multiset of values considered distinct sequences if they satisfy the conditions?
Are the S_i required to be pairwise coprime, or only that the gcd of the entire sequence is 1?
When computing f(S_i/S_{i+1}), should the fraction be reduced to lowest terms before multiplying numerator and denominator, or is it defined directly as P*Q where P/Q is the reduced form?
Can S_i and S_{i+1} share common factors as long as the reduced fraction's numerator and denominator product equals A_i?
Is the modulo operation applied only at the end to the sum of scores, or should each score be computed modulo 998244353 before summing?
Are there any constraints on the magnitude of S_i values, or can they be arbitrarily large positive integers?
Should the sum of scores be taken over all sequences S that satisfy the conditions, or only over sequences up to some equivalence (e.g., scaling by a common factor)?
Is the sequence A guaranteed to be such that at least one good sequence exists? If not, should the output be 0?
